integrity: All-order proof uses exact barycentric facet normals, two graph-theoretic bounds via the Wiener index and low-degree branch currents, and explicit pseudoinverse potentials for path and star; a finite exact-rational checker corroborates, but does not replace, those proofs.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted finite simple trees in the full zero-sum Euclidean realization of the Laplacian columns; no claim of exact fixed-order path/star extremizers, general-graph radii, or lattice-coordinate invariance. The generic incenter formula is not asserted new.
title: Tree Laplacian simplices exhibit sharp, lattice-invisible Euclidean inradius exponents
